text: Election of the Chair of the Nominating Panel - Multi-Tenant House Licensing Tribunal under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A2, for a term of office until a successor is appointed.

The Nominating Panel - Multi-Tenant House Licensing Tribunal: 1. Elected Kenneth Richard as Chair of the Nominating Panel - Multi-Tenant House Licensing Tribunal for a term of office until a successor is appointed.
